scientific_integrity: The claimed results are analytically proved in RESULT.md; numerical checks are finite supplementary tests and do not establish limits. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The polynomial degree and radial weight parameters remain fixed in the singular near-boundary limit.
Leading asymptotics do not determine finite-cutoff corrections or spectra for nonpolynomial weights.
The 2015 trace-ideal article could not be examined beyond bibliographic and abstract evidence; publication priority remains uncertain.
title: Universal singular-value boundary law for polynomially weighted Fock dilations
